existing_system_baseline: The existing Airflow container executes the repository pipeline runner against configuration shared with Windows host paths and a mounted container data root.

architecture_delta.before: Core pipeline path resolution accepted native absolute paths but did not translate a configured Windows data-root path before a POSIX container treated it as project-relative.
architecture_delta.after: Core path resolution first considers the configured host-to-container data-root mapping when it is absolute for the current runtime, while preserving native Windows absolute paths on the host.

changed_existing_boundaries.before: A Windows drive path in runtime configuration became a relative path below the repository when evaluated by pathlib in the Linux Airflow container.
changed_existing_boundaries.after: The same configured value resolves below the mounted container data root on POSIX and remains the original drive path on Windows.

failure_and_rca.failure: The first real local Spark probe exited before creating a Spark session.
failure_and_rca.root_cause: The Airflow image installed PySpark without a Java runtime.
failure_and_rca.correction: The existing Airflow image now includes a pinned Java 17 runtime and JAVA_HOME.
failure_and_rca.retest: A bounded local Spark computation completed in the rebuilt Airflow container.

failure_and_rca.failure: The successful Spark computation wrote its report below a project-relative drive-name directory instead of the mounted evidence root.
failure_and_rca.root_cause: Shared PipelineContext path resolution did not apply the existing host-to-container data-root mapping.
failure_and_rca.correction: Core path resolution now selects the mapped path only when it is absolute for the current runtime, preserving host compatibility.
failure_and_rca.retest: Focused tests, the full 590-test suite, and an in-container path-contract probe passed. The Spark execution must still be rerun to create accepted evidence.

unresolved: The remediated Spark evidence path has not yet been exercised by a fresh run and sealed by digest.
No fresh trace has linked the existing API, queue, worker, Airflow, data, Spark, MLflow, and serving boundaries.
The bounded metric closure and three independent low-load controls remain unexecuted.
private_evidence: Raw failed and partial runtime outputs remain outside Git and are not acceptance evidence.
claim_boundary: This proves a cross-platform path-resolution remediation and regression compatibility. It is not accepted Spark runtime evidence, S0 acceptance, distributed Spark, scale, availability, or production proof.
